name: OPQA
intro: OPQA（OpenAI-Proof Q&A）是 OpenAI 的内部研究与工程诊断评测，由 20 个真实项目瓶颈构成；每个问题都曾让团队耗时超过一天并延误重大项目。模型可访问包含历史代码和运行产物的容器，需要定位并解释性能回退、训练指标异常或隐蔽实现缺陷，按 pass@1 评分。
build_method: 真实内部案例筛选, 历史证据封装
task_type: Agent任务, 代码调试, 研究工程诊断
eval_feature: 内部评测, 代码执行环境
task_type_en: Agent task, code debugging, research engineering diagnosis
build_method_en: Real Internal Case Selection, Historical Evidence Packaging
eval_feature_en: Internal Evaluation, Containerized Code and Run Artifacts
intro_en: OPQA (OpenAI-Proof Q&A) is OpenAI's internal research and engineering diagnosis evaluation built from 20 real project bottlenecks. Each problem took a team more than a day to solve and delayed a major project. Models receive a container with historical code and run artifacts, diagnose issues such as performance regressions, anomalous training metrics, or subtle implementation bugs, and are graded with pass@1.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official GPT-5 system card's OPQA section. The diagrams preserve the 20 real internal research and engineering bottlenecks, the more-than-one-day team-delay inclusion criterion, impact on major projects and sometimes training runs or launches, representative failure types, container access to historical code and run artifacts, diagnosis-and-explanation objective, and pass@1 scoring. Because OPQA is in-house, the diagrams explicitly mark task-authoring, reference-answer, and grader implementation details as undisclosed rather than inventing them.
